checks.title: A System Manager with an email address
checks.why: System notices (the leaver-check summary, waiting-for-access alerts) go to System Managers by email. With no address they reach nobody.
checks.message: No System Manager has an email address. That is expected on a development server, which nobody relies on for notices.

checks.title: Recommended deployment variables
checks.why: A missing recommended variable does not stop the server, but the part that needs it falls back to a default that may not suit a hosted instance.

checks.title: Settings file applied
checks.why: The settings file in the instance repository decides this instance's settings. Until it is applied, they are whatever was set by hand, and none of them is locked.
checks.message: Settings are managed in Featherbase. A managed settings file is optional.

history.message: Settings are managed in Featherbase. A managed settings file is optional.

checks.title: Settings match the file
checks.why: The file is the record of this instance's settings. A value changed outside it is lost at the next apply, and missing from the file's history.
checks.message: Nothing to compare until the settings file is applied.

history.message: Nothing to compare until the settings file is applied.
